identitySignals: Name matches 'NV5 Consultants, Inc.', listed as a subsidiary (doing business as NV5) of NV5 Global, Inc. in its SEC annual report exhibit 21.1
NV5 has a San Rafael, CA office (former Sage Energy Consulting, acquired by NV5 Global in 2021), matching the agenda location San Rafael, CA
NV5 offers solar PV consulting for school districts, matching OUSD's 'Phase II & III PV Project' and school facilities contracts
research.notes: The SEC subsidiary list shows two separate entities named NV5 Consultants, Inc. (Massachusetts and Minnesota); it was not verified which one OUSD contracts with, and no California Secretary of State record was checked. NV5 Global, Inc. is the parent (HQ Hollywood, FL); contact details were left out because the main phone and email on nv5.com belong to the parent, not necessarily to the San Rafael office or the contracting entity.

profile.summary: NV5 is an engineering, testing, inspection and consulting firm for the built environment, working in areas such as infrastructure, utilities and building technology. Its clean energy practice offers solar photovoltaic (PV) consulting, including feasibility studies, procurement and commissioning, for clients such as school districts. NV5 Consultants, Inc. is a subsidiary of NV5 Global, Inc.
